QuestInfo.name: [Star Force] A Suspicious Light
QuestInfo.0: Something strange is going on in #m240000000#. Talk to #b#p2081000##k. \r\n
QuestInfo.1: #p2081000# saw a strange light falling from the sky last night. He isn't sure what that light was because he's too old and frail to see well. Search for other Halflingers who may have seen the light. \r\n
QuestInfo.2: You heard from #p2081004# about the light that #p2081000# mentioned. It was the #bfalling stars#k.\r\n

0.0: I may be old, and blind as an eyeless dog, but I know I saw a #rlight falling from the sky#k last night, and it gave me a weird feeling... \r\n
0.1: It fell into the forest outside of town. Maybe it's good. Maybe it's bad. But it's my job to figure it out. So I hereby officially assign you the task of figuring it out.\r\n

yes.0: But it was so late at night. Did anyone else see it? Your first task: Ask around!\r\n

no.0: It wasn't just any old light. It was bright enough to light up Leafre like it was daytime.\r\n

1.0: That pretty light from last night? Yup, of course I saw it!

yes.0: It was the light of a #rfalling star#k, a huge, bright falling star.

default.0: Today, I feel great! Because yesterday...\r\n

npc.0: It wasn't just any old light... I must find out what it was!

speech.0: Last night? Oh, don't even start. The fruit I had must have gone bad. I was in and out of the bathroom the whole night long. I didn't have time to star gaze. W-wait, my tummy is hurting again, urgh...
I have no idea what happened last night. I fell asleep early. Looking after an egg is tiring, but I still love it!
Lights in the sky last night? I didn't step one foot out of the house because of my egg. I think it's going to hatch soon, hehe.
